sentences.en: Now give attention to what I am going to say.
Few books of this character have come to my attention.
sentences.zh: 我注意到很少有这样的书。

sentences.en: You must concentrate your attention on what you are doing.
sentences.zh: 你必须把注意力集中在你正在做的事情上。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：at（加强）+tent（伸展）+ion（表名词）→伸展出去（听别人讲）→专心
